targets.rawSql:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    (CASE '$report_period'
      WHEN 'today'      THEN date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')
      WHEN 'this_week'  THEN date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')
      WHEN 'this_month' THEN date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')
      WHEN 'last_week'  THEN date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh') - INTERVAL '7 days'
      WHEN 'last_month' THEN date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh') - INTERVAL '1 month'
    END) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh' AS range_start,
    (CASE '$report_period'
      WHEN 'today'      THEN date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh') + INTERVAL '1 day'
      WHEN 'this_week'  THEN date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh') + INTERVAL '7 days'
      WHEN 'this_month' THEN date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh') + INTERVAL '1 month'
      WHEN 'last_week'  THEN date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')
      WHEN 'last_month' THEN date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')
    END) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh' AS range_end,
    CASE '$report_period'
      WHEN 'today' THEN INTERVAL '1 hour'
      ELSE INTERVAL '1 day'
    END AS bucket_width
)
SELECT
  c.bucket AS time,
  m.description,
  c.kwh AS value
FROM params p
CROSS JOIN LATERAL consumption_kwh(p.range_start, p.range_end, p.bucket_width) c
JOIN meters m ON m.meter_id = c.meter_id
WHERE m.is_main = FALSE
  AND m.meter_type = 'electricity'
  AND m.zone IN ($zone)
ORDER BY time ASC;
